newsitem.title: USA: U.S. senator calls on Swiss to open archives.
newsitem.headline: U.S. senator calls on Swiss to open archives.

text.p: Senator Alfonse D'Amato called on Switzerland Thursday to agree to an independent search of archives to uncover the truth about assets deposited in Swiss banks by victims of the Nazi Holocaust.

In a letter to the Swiss ambassador, the New York Republican, who is chairman of the Senate Banking Committee, also asked the Swiss to set up an independent commission to gather information about collaboration by Swiss banks and other entities with the Nazis.
"We should not sweep this under the rug of history," D'Amato said.

He called on the Swiss government to make public all documents, letters and treaties on deals made after World War II with countries regarding disposition of Jewish assets deposited in Swiss banks for safekeeping.
